name: red-evidence-subsystem-spec
title: Author the trusted RED-evidence subsystem decision spec (program Workstream 2)
description: The repro-first enforce program (docs/requirements/decisions/repro-first-gate-enforce-execution-plan.md, Workstream 2) requires a PLAN-reviewed decision spec for the trusted RED evidence subsystem before its implementation stories: today red_evidence_create records self-reported RED runs with no policy-owned assertion envelope, no runner invariance proof, no supersedes-chain integrity, and no idempotency/quarantine semantics, so a fabricated or stale RED record can satisfy the ProofStory red_evidence gate. Deliverable: docs/requirements/decisions/red-evidence-subsystem-spec.md covering the five spec areas the program plan enumerates, cross-host audited, landing as the contract for the W2 implementation stories.
